name: Apoorva Sharma
summary:
▶ Strategic HR Business Partner with 15+ years of experience driving people strategy and
organizational effectiveness across EPC, infrastructure, and energy sectors.
▶ Trusted advisor to CXOs and senior leadership, aligning workforce planning, succession
management, and performance strategy with long-term business growth objectives.
▶ Expertise in talent architecture, leading end-to-end hiring up to Vice President level and
strengthening leadership pipelines through data-led recruitment models.
▶ Builder of high-performance cultures, designing learning & development frameworks,
succession plans, and engagement initiatives to improve productivity and retention.
▶ Operationally strong HR leader with ownership of HR governance, including PMS, payroll,
compliance, budgeting, policy formulation, and HR digitization.
▶ Analytics-driven HR professional leveraging dashboards and workforce insights to enable
informed decision-making and process improvement.
▶ Proven change enabler, delivering structured onboarding and leadership communication
platforms to enhance employee experience and alignment.
